# Entrepreneurs HQ

> > Entrepreneurs HQ is a comprehensive resource for building and scaling coaching businesses, featuring guides on certifications, client acquisition, and high-ticket offer creation.

The site provides actionable frameworks for aspiring and established coaches across wellness, business, and leadership niches. Key resources include the Magic Pill Offer Workshop, Predictable Income System, and Workshop To Client Funnel methodology developed by Liam Austin.

## Key Topics

- Magic Pill Offer Workshop
- Predictable Income System
- Workshop To Client Funnel
- Coaching business scaling
- High-ticket client acquisition
- Coaching certifications
- YouTube marketing for coaches
- Virtual event strategy
- Wellness coaching niches
- Leadership development
- Cognitive behavioral therapy techniques
- Professional coaching skills
- Lead generation funnels
- Marshall Goldsmith methodology
- Lisa Nichols and Les Brown insights

## Core Coaching Business Systems

- [Sales - Workshop - Magic Pill Offer #2 $67](https://entrepreneurshq.com/irresistible-offer-up): Magic Pill Offer Workshop: Create coaching offers that sell for $67
- [How to Scale a Coaching Business: 2026 Guide (70 Methods + Checklist)](https://entrepreneurshq.com/how-to-scale-a-coaching-business): 70 methods to scale coaching business with group programs & high-ticket offers
- [Get Coaching Clients with YouTube in 7 Steps: Examples + 2026 Guide](https://entrepreneurshq.com/get-coaching-clients-with-youtube): 7-step guide to attracting coaching clients via YouTube marketing
- [How to Host a Virtual Summit in 12 Steps (2026 Guide, Plan + Examples)](https://entrepreneurshq.com/virtual-summit): 12-step guide to hosting virtual summits with speaker outreach tips
